parts.html: The K-20 kitchen model brings together a warm beige palette, a contemporary appearance, and a practical U-shaped configuration. With cabinetry arranged along three sides, the model provides a structured kitchen workspace while maintaining a calm, cohesive look.

Its defining feature is the three-sided layout. Rather than placing all kitchen functions along one wall, the U-shaped arrangement allows work surfaces, appliances, and cabinet storage to be distributed across separate sections. This creates flexibility when planning food preparation, cooking, and everyday kitchen tasks.

With 5.1 linear meters of cabinetry, K-20 offers space for upper and lower cabinets, built-in appliances, and essential kitchen equipment. The exact positions of the sink, hob, and appliances can be determined when the model is adapted to the dimensions and service connections of a particular room.

The beige finish gives the furniture a soft, understated character. Its solid-color cabinet fronts can be paired with light walls, natural wood, ceramic tile, and stone-effect materials, allowing the kitchen to fit into a range of contemporary interior schemes.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard. Using the same material and finish throughout creates a consistent furniture composition. The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard, while the countertop is chipboard-based.

The K-20 model does not include a separate kitchen island. Its main working and storage areas are integrated into the U-shaped layout, allowing the central floor area to be planned around comfortable movement between the three sides.

The standard configuration includes cabinet handles, Muller hinges without soft-close, and telescopic drawer runners without soft-close. The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Pull-out cargo storage and lift mechanisms are not included.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments, private residences, and residential interiors in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-20 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, including the lengths of its cabinet runs, the arrangement of work surfaces, and the positions of built-in appliances. Planning takes account of the room layout, plumbing and electrical connections, and the client’s storage requirements.

Our services include kitchen planning, material and hardware selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and appliances can also be selected according to the client’s requirements.
